import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["invoices"].copy()

    amount = df["amount"]
    tax = df["tax"]
    due_date = df["due_date"]
    customer_ref = df["customer_ref"]

    r1 = amount.isna() | (amount < 0)
    r2 = tax.isna() | (tax < 0)
    r3 = (~amount.isna()) & (~tax.isna()) & (tax > amount * 0.5)
    r4 = due_date.isna()
    r5 = customer_ref.isna() | (customer_ref.astype(str).str.strip() == "")

    def build_codes(row_idx):
        codes = []
        if r1.iloc[row_idx]:
            codes.append("AMT_BAD")
        if r2.iloc[row_idx]:
            codes.append("TAX_BAD")
        if r3.iloc[row_idx]:
            codes.append("TAX_EXCESS")
        if r4.iloc[row_idx]:
            codes.append("DUE_NULL")
        if r5.iloc[row_idx]:
            codes.append("REF_EMPTY")
        return "|".join(codes)

    reason_codes = [build_codes(i) for i in range(len(df))]
    df["reason_codes"] = reason_codes

    is_clean = df["reason_codes"] == ""

    invoices_clean = df[is_clean].drop(columns=["reason_codes"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    invoices_rejects = df[~is_clean].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "invoices_clean": invoices_clean,
        "invoices_rejects": invoices_rejects,
    }
